ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback on September 3, 2026, repurchasing 31,571 equity shares at an average price of ₹ 295.39. This latest transaction brings the cumulative shares bought back under the program to 973,456. The ongoing buyback is a strategic move to reduce outstanding shares, potentially enhancing earnings per share and signaling management's confidence in the company's valuation, with no red flags identified in this routine regulatory filing.
